commit_subject: vendor: add kimi/deepseek guard regression coverage
objective: restore Kimi K2 SOTA support on the merged DeepSeek/Kimi vendor branch while preserving DeepSeek behavior

source_fixes.summary: Allow Kimi K2 GGUFs that report arch=deepseek2 and have a Kimi model name to keep deferred expert tensors on CPU while applying GPU layers.
Restore Kimi K2 top-k expert selection for the deepseek2 384-expert single-group layout without changing ordinary DeepSeek2 grouped routing.
Keep Kimi K2 YaRN yarn_log_multiplier semantics at the stored 0.1000 value while preserving the DeepSeek2 conversion-factor correction for non-Kimi models.
Fix batched MMVQ to pass the per-active-expert device pointer d_src0_row instead of the base pointer d_src0.

Centralize the narrow Kimi-vs-DeepSeek guard predicates and add a model-free regression test that ordinary DeepSeek2 grouped routing, tensor placement, and YaRN graph scaling remain on the DeepSeek path.

failed_before_fix.reason: deferred expert GPU override did not apply to Kimi K2 arch=deepseek2, causing a 385415.44 MiB CUDA allocation attempt
batched MMVQ used the wrong expert pointer; YaRN/top-k/defer fixes alone were insufficient

same_host_original_kimi_ab_baseline.purpose: Check whether the merged repair regressed Kimi token rate, or whether the current host simply no longer reproduces the fastest 1.38 tok/s run.
same_host_original_kimi_ab_baseline.comparison: On the same host and current IO state, original Kimi 9820ecbbb ran slower than the pushed merged repair repeat (1.34 tok/s vs 1.36 tok/s). This supports classifying the missing 1.38 reproduction as host/IO variance rather than a merged-branch Kimi regression.

kimi_validation.decision: Kimi correctness, 16GB RAM, TTFT, deferred expert loading, YaRN semantics, and SOTA-shaped expert-pack counters are restored. The pushed-state repeat is in the prior accepted 1.36 tok/s band but did not reproduce the fastest 1.38 tok/s run on this host; the same-host original Kimi A/B baseline also only reached 1.34 tok/s, so the remaining delta is dominated by current host/IO variance rather than the merged repair.

coverage: Kimi K2 arch=deepseek2 + model-name guard defers expert tensors under GPU offload
ordinary DeepSeek2 model names do not use the Kimi tensor-placement override
Kimi K2 384-expert single-group layout uses plain top-k
ordinary grouped DeepSeek2 keeps the argsort/grouped-routing path
Kimi graph YaRN uses the stored multiplier directly
ordinary DeepSeek2 graph YaRN keeps the upstream convert-factor correction

pushed_commit_ctest_subset.scope: This verifies available non-model DeepSeek/Kimi regressions on the pushed branch. It does not replace a full DeepSeek SOTA cold-start run because the validation host still lacks the required DeepSeek GGUF and accepted gate expert pack.

deepseek_validation.prior_merge_probe_status: DeepSeek strict cold run passed correctness/RAM/TTFT constraints at the merge checkpoint, but was below the accepted 4.4 tok/s SOTA.

current_host_asset_audit.available_models: Only Kimi-K2.7-Code-GGUF-IQ3_S was found under /root/lfz/models on the validation host.

reproduction_entrypoint_fix.summary: The strict DeepSeek reproduction entrypoints now default to the current checkout instead of the removed /root/lfz/vendor/llama.cpp-deepseek-v4 path. demo_current_sota.sh also checks the current binary, current profile, model GGUF, and accepted gate pack before launching.
validation: .Agent/examples/demo_current_sota.sh --print-command exits 2 on the validation host and reports the two actual missing artifacts: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-FP4-FP8-native.gguf and ds4-france-gate-miss-firstorder-20260702.pack

deepseek_validation.reason_not_run: The validation host lacks the DeepSeek GGUF and accepted gate expert pack required by the strict DeepSeek SOTA runner.
deepseek_validation.preservation_scope: The Kimi-specific graph/model changes are guarded by Kimi model name or by the Kimi K2 384-expert single-group layout. Ordinary DeepSeek2 grouped routing and the non-Kimi YaRN correction remain on the merged DeepSeek path. The MMVQ pointer fix is a correctness fix for batched expert rows.
